'''WED-9-M1''', nicknamed "'''[[Bantha/Legends|Bantha]]'''" for its slow and stubborn personality, was a unique [[WED Treadwell repair droid/Legends|WED Treadwell repair droid]] cobbled together by [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] and seen around [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. It was later owned by [[Chachi De Maal/Legends|Chachi]] and [[Ohwun De Maal/Legends|Ohwun De Maal]].
